A1.justification: Both PDFs describe PatternKV. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices are readable and support reliable comparison, including matching material across renumbering and layout changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original LongBench and mathematical-reasoning evaluations, component ablations, cache-pattern analyses, and throughput and memory measurements.

after.justification: v2 retains those empirical results and adds component profiling, comparisons against quantized baselines, and cache-pattern observations for ALiBi and MLA models.

M1.justification: The clustering objective, Chebyshev-center updates, min–max pattern selection, residual quantization, and adaptive V threshold remain unchanged. New Section 3.4 describes GPU parallelization and fused kernels implementing these operations, without establishing a different quantization algorithm.

E1.justification: The same LongBench tasks, GSM8K, AIME 2024/2025, and AMC 2023/2024 remain covered. The ALiBi and MLA additions examine different model configurations; they do not establish new datasets, domains, or task requirements.

E2.justification: v1's efficiency comparison includes only FP16 and PatternKV. v2 Appendix I adds KIVI, OTT, ZipCache, and SKVQ to the corresponding latency, throughput, and memory comparisons. Comparator membership in the retained accuracy evaluations is unchanged.

E3.justification: The main accuracy protocols and original H20 profiling settings remain unchanged. Added analyses introduce component latency and GFLOPs measurements at batch size 32 and diagnostic configurations using MPT-7B-Chat and DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat. Newly specified prompts and GSM8K INT2 precision are disclosures rather than demonstrated revisions to existing experiments.

E4.justification: Appendix I adds a computational-overhead breakdown for mining, selection, and center updates. Appendices J–K add analyses testing whether K drift persists under ALiBi and whether the observed cache structure extends to MLA. The original component and pattern-count accuracy ablations are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report eight independent reasoning responses with Avg@8 and Maj@8. v2 adds no experimental seed counts, confidence intervals, significance tests, or other uncertainty-reporting procedures. The adaptive threshold's statistical derivation is also unchanged.

E6.justification: Existing accuracy and ablation values are unchanged, including the equivalent redisplay of GSM8K scores. v2 adds substantial efficiency results in Tables 9–12 and ALiBi/MLA findings. For example, new Table 11 reports 2682.75 tokens/s for PatternKV versus 3605.49 for KIVI at batch size 128.

T1.justification: The original mathematical arguments and finite-pattern error-bound proof are retained, with the proof moving from Appendix D to C. New Appendix I.3 adds analytical memory calculations, including prefill and decoding overhead ratios of 32/(BS) and 1/(B Gpattern).

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction increase the claimed throughput advantage from 1.4× to 1.5×. The central distribution-flattening contribution, accuracy claims, and 1.25× batch-capacity claim remain substantively unchanged.

C2.justification: v2 uses the ALiBi comparison to attribute smooth K drift primarily to RoPE and argues for direct MLA applicability while acknowledging that further validation is needed. It also adds substantive interpretations of the accuracy–speed tradeoff against KIVI and implementation-dependent memory costs of competing methods.

D1.justification: v2 documents GPU-parallel KMeans and two fused CUDA kernels and provides a code-repository link. It also supplies the preliminary experiments' GSM8K prompt, explicitly identifies GSM8K results as INT2, and explains the already-existing KIVI/OTT residual-buffer settings. These substantially expand implementation and reproduction information.

R1.justification: The cited works and Section 5's positioning against outlier handling, mixed precision, codebook compression, and pruning remain substantively unchanged. Bibliographic abbreviation and formatting changes do not introduce different references or novelty claims.

P1.justification: Most existing prose and the main narrative order are retained. v2 adds Section 3.4, rewrites the efficiency discussion, and reorganizes the appendices. It removes the separate ethics, reproducibility, and LLM-use statements and introduces an impact statement.

P2.justification: v2 substantially redesigns the presentation with a two-column main text, an expanded Figure 1, and a redrawn GSM8K chart showing absolute accuracy instead of accuracy drops. The earlier efficiency plot is replaced by expanded tables, and new ALiBi/MLA figures accompany extensive resizing and relocation of retained displays.

improvement.justification: The quantized-baseline efficiency comparisons and component profiling make costs and tradeoffs substantially easier to assess than v1's FP16-only plot. Implementation details, the prompt, and code-access information also improve reproducibility. These benefits are tempered by weaknesses in the additions: Appendix I.3 incorrectly describes INT2 values as occupying two bytes, and MLA applicability is inferred from cache visualizations without end-to-end quantization validation.
